newsitem.title: GERMANY: Dasa in cooperation talks with Schleicher.
newsitem.headline: Dasa in cooperation talks with Schleicher.

text.p: Daimler-Benz Aerospace AG (Dasa) and Schleicher GmbH & Co of Berlin are holding talks on merging their machine control systems operations, a company mediating the talks said in a statement on Friday.

Both companies are working on joint projects which have backing under a Berlin city administration technology scheme, and Schleicher said it expected to take control of operations, investment firm BDO Corporate Finance GmbH said.

Dasa confirmed the BDO statement, but gave no further details. Dasa, a lossmaking company which accounts for 75 percent of German aerospace output, has developed a system for controlling machinery to help accelerate product development.
Schleicher is a 60-year-old family-owned company based in Berlin which produces a wide range of components for automating production.
